records.jp: は～……<CR>こうして、まったり過ごすのもいいよねえ
records.en_original: Ahhh... It's nice to relax like this sometimes.
records.en: Ahhh... It's nice to relax like this sometimes.

records.jp: 畳。そして縁側。<CR>ここはまさに、心のふるさと……
records.en_original: Tatami mats... An open veranda... It soothes the soul.
records.en: Tatami mats... An open veranda... It soothes the soul.

records.jp: 分かる、分かる！<CR>畳と、縁側と、あと……
records.en_original: Totally! Although, there is one thing missing...
records.en: Totally! Although, there is one thing missing...

records.jp: お茶があったら最高だよね
records.en_original: Some tea!
records.en: Some tea!

records.jp: まさに、至高……
records.en_original: That does sound wonderful...
records.en: That does sound wonderful...

records.jp: さらに、ミカンとお煎餅があってもいい
records.en_original: Some tangerines and crackers would also be perfect.
records.en: Some tangerines and crackers would also be perfect.

records.jp: あ～、たしかに。<CR>それは、やばいね～
records.en_original: Oh man, that would be great.
records.en: Oh man, that would be great.

records.jp: 唐揚げがあったら最高だよね！
records.en_original: Some fried chicken!
records.en: Some fried chicken!

records.jp: ……唐揚げ？
records.en_original: Fried chicken?
records.en: Fried chicken?

records.jp: 縁側で夏の風を感じながら食べる唐揚げは<CR>最高に美味しいと思うんだよね～！
records.en_original: Nothing says hanging out outside during the summer like some fried chicken, right?
records.en: Nothing says hanging out outside during the summer like some fried chicken, right?

records.jp: 愛央……唐揚げ食べたいだけ？
records.en_original: You just want to eat fried chicken, don't you?
records.en: You just want to eat fried chicken, don't you?

records.jp: ん～、そうかも！
records.en_original: Probably, yeah!
records.en: Probably, yeah!

records.jp: ……そんな話するから、お腹空いてきた
records.en_original: ...All this talk has gotten me hungry as well.
records.en: ...All this talk has gotten me hungry as well.

records.jp: あはは、私も！
records.en_original: Ahaha, me too!
records.en: Ahaha, me too!

records.jp: 何かないかなぁ……
records.en_original: I wonder if there's anything around...
records.en: I wonder if there's anything around...

records.jp: あ、クッキーがある！<CR>これ、一緒に食べよっか！
records.en_original: Oooh, we have cookies! Wanna share?
records.en: Oooh, we have cookies! Wanna share?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Please.
records.en: Please.

records.jp: あー、美味しかった！<CR>小腹に丁度良かったねー
records.en_original: That hit the spot! A perfect snack!
records.en: That hit the spot! A perfect snack!

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: Is something the matter?
records.en: Is something the matter?

records.jp: このクッキー……勇希のだったかも
records.en_original: These cookies... I think they belonged to Yuki.
records.en: These cookies... I think they belonged to Yuki.

records.jp: えっ、まじで！？
records.en_original: Wait, really?!
records.en: Wait, really?!

records.jp: まじで。今、そんな気がした
records.en_original: Really. I realized just now.
records.en: Really. I realized just now.

records.jp: じゃあ、二人で勇希にあやまらないとね
records.en_original: We better go apologize to Yuki.
records.en: We better go apologize to Yuki.

records.jp: きらら、共犯にされた
records.en_original: You've made me into your accomplice.
records.en: You've made me into your accomplice.

records.jp: いや、だって一緒に食べたじゃん！
records.en_original: You ate just as many cookies as I did!
records.en: You ate just as many cookies as I did!

records.jp: クッキー見つけたのは愛央……
records.en_original: You were the one who found them...
records.en: You were the one who found them...

records.jp: そうだけど、勇希のだって<CR>教えてくれなかったでしょ
records.en_original: Yeah, but you never told me that they were Yuki's!
records.en: Yeah, but you never told me that they were Yuki's!

records.jp: その時は、神様の声聞こえなかった
records.en_original: That's because the Divine didn't tell me.
records.en: That's because the Divine didn't tell me.

records.jp: こんな時ばかり、神様つかうのズルイって！
records.en_original: Hey, using the Divine as an excuse is super unfair!
records.en: Hey, using the Divine as an excuse is super unfair!

records.jp: だ、大丈夫！<CR>黙ってれば分からないって
records.en_original: D-don't worry! She'll never know if we don't tell her.
records.en: D-don't worry! She'll never know if we don't tell her.

records.jp: きらら、黙ってる自信ない
records.en_original: I don't know if I can keep it a secret...
records.en: I don't know if I can keep it a secret...

records.jp: ですよねー
records.en_original: No surprises there...
records.en: No surprises there...

records.jp: 食べてしまったもんは仕方ない！<CR>後でちゃんと、謝ろ！
records.en_original: Oh well, what's eaten is eaten! We'll apologize later.
records.en: Oh well, what's eaten is eaten! We'll apologize later.

records.jp: でも、怒るだろうなぁ……
records.en_original: She'll probably be super mad, though...
records.en: She'll probably be super mad, though...

records.jp: 賄賂を渡せばいい
records.en_original: Then we pay her off.
records.en: Then we pay her off.

records.jp: あ、クッキーの代わりになるものってこと？
records.en_original: Ahh, in exchange for the cookies?
records.en: Ahh, in exchange for the cookies?

records.jp: そう
records.en_original: Exactly.
records.en: Exactly.

records.jp: 賄賂ねえ……
records.en_original: Pay her off, huh...
records.en: Pay her off, huh...

records.jp: 賄賂って言ったら、やっぱり金のお菓子かな
records.en_original: Time to give bribe her with the most delicious thing of all... Cold hard cash.
records.en: Time to give bribe her with the most delicious thing of all... Cold hard cash.

records.jp: 越後屋……おぬしも悪よのう
records.en_original: Ho ho, delightfully devilish.
records.en: Ho ho, delightfully devilish.

records.jp: いえいえ、お代官様こそ
records.en_original: You do flatter me.
records.en: You do flatter me.

records.jp: ……勇希、金のお菓子は喜ばないと思う
records.en_original: ...Yuki doesn't seem the type to enjoy being gifted money.
records.en: ...Yuki doesn't seem the type to enjoy being gifted money.

records.jp: さすがに現金はないかー
records.en_original: Yeah... I guess that wasn't such a great idea.
records.en: Yeah... I guess that wasn't such a great idea.

records.jp: もし神様の声が聞こえたら、<CR>普通のお菓子のほうが良いって言うはず
records.en_original: I'm sure the Divine would recommend just regular sweets.
records.en: I'm sure the Divine would recommend just regular sweets.

records.jp: だね！<CR>んじゃ、なんか甘いもの探しに行こっか！
records.en_original: Sounds good to me! Let's go see if we can't find something!
records.en: Sounds good to me! Let's go see if we can't find something!

records.jp: だとしたら、勇希の好きなものがいいよね
records.en_original: Then let's get her something she likes.
records.en: Then let's get her something she likes.

records.jp: 好きなもの……むう。<CR>神様の声が聞こえれば、分かるのに
records.en_original: Something she likes... If only I could hear the Divine...
records.en: Something she likes... If only I could hear the Divine...

records.jp: え、神様ってそんなんも知ってるの？
records.en_original: The Divine knows stuff like that?
records.en: The Divine knows stuff like that?

records.jp: うむ。神様は、いろんな所から見てるから
records.en_original: Indeed. The gods see everything, after all.
records.en: Indeed. The gods see everything, after all.

records.jp: へぇー……
records.en_original: Wow.
records.en: Wow.

records.jp: まあ、でも神様に聞くより<CR>本人に聞いたほうが早いか
records.en_original: Though I guess it would be fastest just to ask her ourselves.
records.en: Though I guess it would be fastest just to ask her ourselves.

records.jp: ……突撃謝罪する？
records.en_original: ...You're going to admit you ate her cookies?
records.en: ...You're going to admit you ate her cookies?

records.jp: する！　んで、勇希の好きなものを<CR>お詫びに奢る！
records.en_original: Yup. And then to make up for what we did, we'll get Yuki her favorite treat!
records.en: Yup. And then to make up for what we did, we'll get Yuki her favorite treat!

records.jp: んで、万事解決っしょ！
records.en_original: Easy-peasy!
records.en: Easy-peasy!

records.jp: ……愛央の行動力すごい
records.en_original: Nothing keeps you down, does it?
records.en: Nothing keeps you down, does it?

records.jp: え、そうかな？　普通だと思うけど
records.en_original: You think? I think I'm pretty normal.
records.en: You think? I think I'm pretty normal.

records.jp: ……きららは、その普通が出来ない
records.en_original: ...That may be, but I don't know if I could do the same.
records.en: ...That may be, but I don't know if I could do the same.

records.jp: え？　何、きらら？
records.en_original: What was that, Kirara?
records.en: What was that, Kirara?

records.jp: なんでもない。勇希のとこ、行こう
records.en_original: Nothing. Let's find Yuki.
records.en: Nothing. Let's find Yuki.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
